create.name: Wayne Muller
create.bio:
Wayne Muller is a minister, writer and spiritual director best known for Sabbath, his book on recovering a rhythm of rest in a culture that prizes constant activity. He trained at Harvard Divinity School and spent decades working alongside people facing poverty, abuse, addiction, illness and loss, an experience that runs through his writing. He founded Bread for the Journey, a network that gives small grants for neighbourhood generosity, and has been a senior scholar at the Fetzer Institute.

His teaching is gentle and contemplative, drawing on Christian, Buddhist and other traditions. He invites people to slow down, to notice what is already enough, and to make space for prayer, stillness and delight rather than adding more effort. Today he works mainly as a private mentor and spiritual director with a small number of people and groups, in person, by phone or online, and he hosts tailored private retreats in Santa Fe, New Mexico, with unhurried days for reflection, walking and rest. Besides Sabbath, his books include Legacy of the Heart, Learning to Pray, How, Then, Shall We Live? and a later book on living with enough.

books.title: Sabbath: Finding Rest, Renewal, and Delight in Our Busy Lives
books.author: Wayne Muller
books.description: His best-known book. It argues that rest is a spiritual necessity rather than a reward, and offers reflections and simple practices from many traditions for setting aside unhurried time.

books.title: A Life of Being, Having, and Doing Enough
books.author: Wayne Muller
books.description: A reflection on how to recognise when we have done and have enough, and on letting that sense of sufficiency shape work, choices and relationships.

books.title: How, Then, Shall We Live? Four Simple Questions That Reveal the Beauty and Meaning of Our Lives
books.author: Wayne Muller
books.description: Built around four plain questions about who we are, what we love, how we will live and what we will leave behind, with stories and practices to explore each one.

books.title: Learning to Pray: How We Find Heaven on Earth
books.author: Wayne Muller
books.description: A slow, line-by-line meditation on the Lord's Prayer, offered as a way into listening and stillness rather than as doctrine.

courses.title: Individual mentorship and spiritual direction
courses.description: Ongoing one-to-one or small-group mentoring, in person, by phone or online, for people in a time of change who want to listen more closely to their sense of calling and meaning. Enquiries go through a form on his site.

courses.title: Private retreats in Santa Fe
courses.description: Retreats of unhurried days in Santa Fe, shaped around one person or a small group of friends or colleagues, with time for reflection, conversation, walking and rest, and follow-up sessions afterwards.
